rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something that completely holds your attention.

example.english: This novel is so engrossing that I can’t stop reading it.
example.traditional: 呢本小說好吸引，我一睇就停唔到。
example.jyutping: ne1 bun2 siu2 syut3 hou2 kap1 jan5 ngo5 jat1 tai2 zau6 ting4 m4 dou3

rows.note: Use this especially for a film, programme, video, or other visual entertainment that is engrossing to watch.

example.english: That documentary is really engrossing; we didn’t want to go to sleep.
example.traditional: 嗰套紀錄片真係好睇，我哋睇到唔捨得瞓。
example.jyutping: go2 tou3 gei2 luk6 pin2 zan1 hai6 hou2 tai2 ngo5 dei6 tai2 dou2 m4 se2 dak1 fan3

rows.note: Use this more formal expression for a compelling story, documentary, or written account, especially in polished descriptions.

example.english: This interview is so engrossing that readers finish it in one go.
example.traditional: 呢篇訪問寫得引人入勝，讀者一口氣讀完。
example.jyutping: ni1 pin1 fong2 man6 se2 dak1 jan5 jan4 jap6 sing3 duk6 ze2 jat1 hau2 hei3 duk6 jyun4
